interpretation.BLiMP: Use blimp_union for the main BLiMP read. The selected worst/control groups are shown only to expose the post-hoc redistribution artifact.
interpretation.EWoK: Uses fast temporal EWoK domain scores. Full official 7618-row EWoK at 100M has a smaller seed gap (-1.6449) and positive seed43122 treatment effect (+1.4617), so do not use this proxy for final EWoK arithmetic.
interpretation.replacement: Replace this proxy with the exact research clean sparse DiD when the exact clean sparse control is available.
